title: Apple Posting Notable Gain After J.P. Morgan Initiates At Overweight
text:
Apple Posting Notable Gain After J.P. Morgan Initiates At Overweight 21: Shares of Apple ( AAPL ) have shown a strong move to the upside during trading on Thursday, with the tech giant jumping by 2.3 percent.
The advance by Apple comes after J.P. Morgan Securities initiated coverage of the company's stock with an Overweight rating. //www.rttnews.com/2938854/apple-posting-notable-gain-after-j-p-morgan-initiates-at-overweight.aspx CLOSE X Edit Favorites
